map.按扣件式钢管脚手架轴心受压稳定思路，计算立杆稳定承载力及施工荷载验算。: Computes upright stability capacity and construction-load check for coupler-type steel-tube scaffolds.
map.「按扣件式钢管脚手架轴心受压稳定思路，计算立杆稳定承载力及施工荷载验算。」按输入: The "Scaffold Bearing Capacity" tool performs a professional calculation from your inputs and outputs the result.
map.计算长度 l₀ = k·h + 2a（扣件式钢管脚手架简化公式）: Effective length l0 = k x h + 2a (simplified coupler-type formula)
map.长细比 λ = l₀ / i，i 为截面回转半径: Slenderness lambda = l0 / i, i = radius of gyration
map.稳定系数 φ 按 a 类截面近似查表（线性插值）: Stability factor phi from class-a section table (linear interp)
map.立杆稳定承载力 N ≤ φ·A·f，其中 f = fy / 抗力分项系数（取 1: Upright capacity N <= phi x A x f, f = fy / resistance factor (1.1)
map.外墙装修搭扣件式钢管架，先按立杆纵距 1.5m、横距 0.9m、步距 1.8m: For exterior decoration scaffolding, first estimate single-upright load at 1.5m bay, 0.9m row and 1.8m lift to judge if the tube is adequate.
map.堆载平台（如放建材）前，用本工具校核施工荷载是否超过单杆容许值，防止局部失稳。: Before a loading platform (e.g. materials), use this tool to check if construction load exceeds the single-upright allowance, preventing local buckling.
map.对比不同步距对稳定性的影响，在满足作业面前提下尽量减小步距提升安全余量。: Compare lift-height effects on stability; where work space allows, reduce lift to improve safety margin.
map.Φ48×3.0 钢管，步距 1.8m，纵距 1.5m\n参考容许荷载约 20–3:

Reference allowance ~20-30kN/post (by code & couplers)
Construction load 2kN/m2 x 1.5 x 0.9 ~ 2.7kN/post, ample margin
map.算出来能直接搭吗？: Can I build directly from the result?
map.不能。脚手架属危险性较大的分部分项工程，须按 JGJ130 等规范由专业人员设计: No. Scaffolding is a high-risk sub-project; it must be designed and accepted by qualified personnel per JGJ130 etc. before use.
map.本工具做竖向荷载初估，风荷载、连墙件与基础沉降需纳入正式计算，高处架体尤其不能忽: This tool estimates vertical load only; wind load, wall ties and foundation settlement need formal calculation, especially for tall scaffolds.
map.不一样。节点刚度与承载力差异明显，须按对应架体类型的计算规则，本工具仅给通用量级: No. Node stiffness and capacity differ greatly; follow the rules for each system. This tool gives only a general magnitude.
map.按立杆间距与步距粗算单杆容许荷载，辅助搭设前初核；正式方案须由持证人员按规范设计: Roughly estimates single-upright allowable load by spacing and lift for pre-check; the formal scheme must be designed by certified staff per code.
